title: Build the Local Signal
principles: name a maintainer before naming a coverage area

layers.name: Low-rate radio
layers.purpose: Short messages, positions, sensor readings, and tiny packets

layers.name: Local compute
layers.purpose: Nearby media, libraries, games, maps, and bulletin boards

layers.name: Satellite ears
layers.purpose: Receive and decode signals from orbit

projects.name: Pocket Relay
projects.openness: open software on supported commodity boards
projects.use: short text, location, and sensor packets
projects.limit: not voice, video, or guaranteed emergency service

projects.name: Field Telephone
projects.openness: open radio system and open network stack
projects.use: messages, files, and local network experiments
projects.needs: two or more compatible boards and hosts
projects.limit: low data rate; band rules vary by place

projects.name: Three Roofs
projects.openness: open router hardware, firmware, and mesh software
projects.needs: permission, safe mounts, and line of sight
projects.limit: a regional radius is a staged network horizon, not one device range

projects.name: Orbit Ear
projects.openness: open software on commodity LoRa boards
projects.needs: a compatible board, antenna, and Wi-Fi
projects.limit: receive project; passes and frequencies vary

projects.name: Satellite Desk
projects.use: track, receive, decode, and contribute observations
projects.needs: receiver, antennas, controller, and clear sky
projects.limit: requires more RF, mechanics, and calibration than TinyGS

projects.name: Offline Library
projects.openness: free software on supported Raspberry Pi hardware
projects.use: a local library, repair cafe, classroom, or road kit
projects.needs: a supported Pi, storage, and selected ZIM files

projects.name: Block TV
projects.openness: open software on a local computer
projects.use: a performance, meeting, game, or porch camera
projects.needs: a computer, Owncast, and a local network
projects.limit: video requires much more bandwidth than LoRa

projects.name: Neighborhood Jukebox
projects.openness: free software on a local computer
projects.use: a listening room, movie night, or oral history shelf
projects.needs: a server, storage, and media you may share
projects.limit: respect copyright, privacy, and contributor consent

projects.name: Radio Window
projects.openness: open software with a commodity receiver
projects.use: shared shortwave, amateur, air, weather, or satellite reception
projects.needs: an SDR receiver, antenna, and local server
projects.limit: receive-only is the clean start; protect private communications

safety: Check local radio rules, permissions, safe mounting, grounding, weather exposure, power, privacy, and content rights. Do not represent a hobby network as certified emergency infrastructure.
